system.description:
Druids who have walked close to the boundary between divine and arcane magic. They don't cross it, but they stand at the edge and look over.

  • Verdant Power: once each round, when a spell you cast deals damage, add your Wisdom modifier to the damage one creature takes.
    • 9th level: two creatures.
  • Deep Roots: add Dispel Magic to your Druid list, and Advantage on checks to identify magic.
